## Vaccine route, orders, names
## __________________________
## Route: IM
## Outpatient HPV orders:
[3 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-human-papillomavirus-vaccine-3-dose-series)
## CPRS name:
PAPILLOMAVIRUS HUMAN
VACCINE INJ,SUSP
## Stocked brand name:
Gardasil 9
## Other names:
Human papillomavirus
(HPV)
References:
Immunization Action
Coalition,
Summary of Adult
Immunizations, 2021, P2011
Freedman et al., Annals of
internal medicine, 2021,
174(3)374-384.
<!-- COLUMN 2 -->
## Recommended populations
## __________________________
*For unvaccinated or
partially vaccinated
adults through age 26yrs:
Complete a 3-dose series
of HPV.
*Unvaccinated adults age
27 through 45yrs may be
vaccinated based on
shared clinical decision-
making.
*Other guidance: Pregnancy
is neither a
contraindication nor a
precaution
to HPV vaccine.
<!-- COLUMN 3 -->
## Administration Schedule
## __________________________
*Give 3 doses on a 0, 1-2,
6-month schedule.
*There must be at least
4wks between doses #1 and
#2 and at least 12wks
between doses #2 and #3.
Overall, there must be at
least 5 months between
doses #1 and #3
*If the type of HPV
vaccine previously given
is not known or not
available, any available
HPV vaccine should be used
to complete the series.
<!-- COLUMN 4 -->
## Contraindications/Precautions
## __________________________
## Contraindications:
History of severe allergic
reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to a previous
dose or a vaccine
component.
## Precautions:
Moderate or severe acute
illness with or
without fever.
